# Search Fixture Quiver

A collection whose arrows are cached into the vault, never into the catalog.

```collection
schema: "collection@v0"

metadata:
  name: "Search Fixture Quiver"
  description: "Curated arrows for search ranking"
  tags:
    - "search"

arrows:
  - namespace: quiver.test/quiver-test/search-widget-beta@v1
```
